name: Mairiporã (Brazil)
description: Blue field with a red horizontal stripe through the centre bearing a thinner yellow stripe, and a white vertical stripe along the hoist bearing the municipal arms.
history: Mairiporã is a municipality in the São Paulo metropolitan area, Brazil, formerly Juqueri and renamed by Law No. 233 of 24 December 1948. Flags of the World notes that a photograph labelled official shows the vertical and horizontal stripes of equal width.

features.role: red stripe bearing a thinner yellow stripe
municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with a landscape and the Southern Cross, with the motto SUB LEGE LIBERTAS
